name: Add onboarding screen for a first run
description:
When rowbly runs for the first time, we should present the user with an onboarding screen

- One screen is shown when rowbly is started for the first time. This is keyed off the users `.rowblyrc.json` in thier home folder.
- For the global onboarding we ask the user for their name and any projects they want to include right away.


- The other screen is on a per-data-root basis.
- Config for this is stored in teh data root and determines if it opens.
- Data root will ask the user how they plan on using rowbly, either as a plain Kanban, a Software Factory or both.
- From there will ask them to create their first board, then whether they want any plugins enabled.
- If software factory plugin is enabled, we guide them through what they need to do for stage prompts, skills, etc.
- Also ask if they plan on using AI (in general, different from software factory) on the project. If they say yes then we guide them through installing default skills + how they can create their own skills.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Initial inspection found blocking onboarding decisions: completion behavior for existing installations, name versus Me handle, registering versus creating Data Roots, and guidance versus automatic factory/skill configuration. Awaiting clarification before implementation.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body:
Answers to FACTORY-QUESTIONS ROW-38 (from the user):

1. **Trigger:** Add explicit completion flags: a global one in `~/.rowblyrc.json` and one per Data Root in its config. A bare TUI launch shows onboarding when the flag is absent, so existing installations see it once. Onboarding can be skipped (skipping sets the flag) and reopened later from Settings.
2. **Global profile:** "Name" is the existing Me handle, not a separate display name. "Projects" means registering existing Data Roots the user points at; onboarding does not create new ones.
3. **Data Root completion:** Shared: the flag lives in the Data Root config (committed with it), so completing it once suppresses it for everyone sharing that Data Root. Skippable and reopenable as above.
4. **Usage modes:** "Software Factory" and "Both" turn on the software-factory Plugin; plain Kanban leaves it off. "Both" also walks through the Kanban Plugin choices (Tasks, Epics, Comments, …) the plain Kanban path offers; "Software Factory" alone skips straight to the factory guidance after creating the Board.
5. **Guidance depth:** Explain Stage Prompts and skills, and offer actions: offer to install the official skills (the same thing `rowbly skills install` does) and to open Stage Prompt editing. Do not write starter Stage Prompt templates automatically.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Accepted complexity-7 plan on codex/row-38-onboarding: persist completion flags, add global and Data Root onboarding, reuse existing Plugin/Board/skill services, expose reopening in Settings, and update documentation. Baseline typecheck, lint, unit 76/76, and CLI 20/20 passed. Implementation underway; independent validation and screenshots follow.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Independent validation passed all four checks and the onboarding flows, but found one bug: an official skill selection can resolve a same-named local folder. Correction is underway; screenshots are captured. The new commit will receive independent revalidation before the draft PR.
